stories.title: Content Engine page shell with tab navigation
acceptanceCriteria: ContentEnginePage renders with 4 tab placeholders (Ideas, Create, Calendar, Brand)
Mobile shows bottom TabBar with icons and labels
Desktop shows left SideTabBar (w-20) with icons and labels
Tab state persists in URL via /create/content-engine/:tab
errorHandling: Invalid tab parameter defaults to 'ideas' tab
Missing route shows 404 page
testSteps: Visit http://localhost:3000/create/content-engine - page renders with Ideas tab active
Click each tab - URL updates and content area changes
Resize browser to mobile width - bottom TabBar appears, side nav hides
stories.loadingState: Glass panel skeleton with tab placeholders
stories.a11y: Tab buttons have aria-selected, aria-controls attributes
stories.mobile: Bottom tab bar with 56px height, touch targets 44x44px minimum

stories.title: TypeScript types for Content Engine models
acceptanceCriteria: IdeaStatus, Platform, ClipStatus union types defined
ContentIdea interface with id, title, description, status, platforms, timestamps
ContentClip interface with id, title, scenes, status, ideaId, timestamps
ScheduledPost interface with id, clipId, platform, scheduledFor, status
BrandVoice interface with tone, personality, topics, colors
testSteps: Import types in a test component - autocomplete works

stories.title: Ideas API service and hooks
acceptanceCriteria: ideasApi object with list, create, update, delete methods
useIdeas hook returns { ideas, isLoading, error, refetch }
useCreateIdea mutation hook for quick capture
useUpdateIdea mutation hook for status changes
errorHandling: Network errors surface through React Query error state
401 errors redirect to login

stories.title: Ideas Tab with list view and quick capture
acceptanceCriteria: QuickCapture input at top of Ideas tab, always visible
IdeaCard shows title, platform badges, status badge
Filter dropdown filters by status (All, Saved, Planned, In Progress, Archived)
Click IdeaCard opens action menu (Archive, Create Clip)
Empty state shows helpful message with QuickCapture
errorHandling: Loading state shows skeleton cards
Error state shows message with retry button
Quick capture shows inline error on failure
testSteps: Type in QuickCapture and submit - new idea appears in list
Change filter to 'Planned' - only planned ideas show
Click an idea card - action menu appears
stories.a11y: Filter dropdown has aria-label, cards are keyboard navigable
stories.mobile: Single column layout, touch-friendly card actions

stories.title: Create Tab with responsive chat layout
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile: Preview at top (9:16 aspect), chat below, input at bottom
Desktop: Chat on left, preview on right (side-by-side)
WebSocket connects when Create tab becomes active
WebSocket disconnects when switching away from Create tab
Preview updates in real-time as AI generates clip
errorHandling: WebSocket connection error shows reconnect button
Network disconnect shows offline indicator
Invalid clip data shows error toast
testSteps: Send a message - AI responds and preview updates
Switch to Ideas tab - WebSocket disconnects (check network tab)
Switch back to Create tab - WebSocket reconnects
Resize to mobile - layout changes to stacked
stories.loadingState: Chat panel shows 'Connecting...' until WebSocket ready
stories.a11y: Chat messages have role='log', input has aria-label

stories.title: Schedule API service and hooks
acceptanceCriteria: scheduleApi object with list, create, update, delete methods
useSchedule hook accepts date range params
useScheduleByDay hook returns events grouped by day
useCreateSchedule mutation hook for scheduling clips
errorHandling: Network errors surface through React Query error state
401 errors redirect to login

stories.title: Calendar Tab with month view
acceptanceCriteria: Month navigation with prev/next arrows
Days with scheduled content show indicator dot
Tap day to see schedule in DaySchedule section below
ScheduleCard shows time, platform badge, clip title
Platform color coding (LinkedIn blue, YouTube red, Twitter cyan)
errorHandling: Loading state shows calendar skeleton
Error state shows message with retry button
Empty day shows 'No content scheduled' message
testSteps: Click a day with content - DaySchedule shows events
Click a day without content - shows empty state
stories.loadingState: Calendar grid skeleton with placeholder cells
stories.a11y: Calendar grid has role='grid', days have aria-selected
stories.mobile: Full-width calendar, scrollable day schedule below

stories.title: Schedule Modal for scheduling clips
acceptanceCriteria: Modal opens from 'Schedule' action in IdeaCard or CalendarTab
Date picker for selecting publish date
Time picker for selecting publish time
Platform checkboxes (LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter)
Submit creates ScheduledPost via API
errorHandling: Past date/time shows validation error
No platform selected shows validation error
API error shows toast with retry option
testSteps: Select date, time, and platform - submit
Try to submit with past date - shows error
stories.loadingState: Submit button shows spinner while saving
stories.a11y: Modal has aria-modal, focus trapped inside
stories.mobile: Full-screen modal with large touch targets

stories.title: Brand Voice Tab
acceptanceCriteria: Tone selector dropdown (Professional, Casual, Friendly, etc.)
Personality traits as editable tag chips
Topics/pillars as editable tag list
Signature phrases textarea
Primary and accent color pickers
Auto-save on changes with success indicator
errorHandling: Loading state shows form skeleton
Save error shows toast with retry
Invalid color value shows inline error
testSteps: Add a personality trait - appears as chip
stories.a11y: Color pickers have aria-label, form fields have labels

Content Engine card has Sparkles icon and prominent styling
/create/social-clip redirects to /create/content-engine/create
/create/brand-voice redirects to /create/content-engine/brand
